name_input: SHYAMPRABHA SMARTPACK PRIVATE LIMITED; SHYAMPRABHA SMARTPACK PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey (India customs export records), slug /countries/india/shyamprabha-smartpack-private-limited: "2026-02-28 | SHYAMPRABHA SMARTPACK PRIVATE LIMITED | TO ORDER NETHERLANDS | OFFSET PRINTED DUPLEX MONO CARTON BOXES(PACKAGING MATERIALS)CARTON BOX 460x310x80mm | MANGALORE SEA INNML1, India | Rotterdam, NETHERLANDS | 48191010 | BOL 1134004". Further rows seen: 2026-02-27 Rotterdam NL, HS 48191010, BOL 1069935; 2026-02-25 Miami USA, HS 48191010, BOL 9997340; 2026-02-18 London Gateway UK, HS 48191010, BOL 9776088; 2026-02-13 Sydney AU, HS 48191010, BOL 9660852. Page counter: "Total Shipments 5761", "Trading Partners 17", "Ports 16", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible on free view: 5 export rows (plus aggregated supplier/buyer/port tables, not individual records). Declared HS 481910 matches the observed customs HS 48191010 — no correction needed.
domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report splits could not be read: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and the web_search backend was unavailable ("Connection refused") for the whole session, so no GST/tender page could be located. Registered address visible in the customs record header: "209 NAV KETAN BLDG N G ACHARYA MAR G,CHEMBUR EAST" (Mumbai), while shipments originate at Mangalore Sea — a second operating location, but this is not supply evidence.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: five dated India customs export records in Feb 2026 to Netherlands, USA, UK and Australia under HS 48191010, each with a bill-of-lading number, all shipped from Mangalore Sea. The company is therefore an active exporter of offset-printed duplex mono carton boxes / cake boards, consistent with the declared HS 481910 (cartons/boxes of paper). Domestic (intra-India) supply is unverified — not because no supply exists, but because every registry and tender source was blocked or unreachable in this session; recorded as unknown with null rather than guessed. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey free view gives only a shipment count (5761 records, all-direction, not a volume or value), so no turnover or tonnage is asserted. Industry label "Строительство и DIY" (construction/DIY) does not match the observed product line (printed paperboard packaging for bakery/food); the HS code is correct, the industry classification appears to be a sourcing-catalogue artefact. No sanctions, litigation or ownership findings were assessed — out of scope for this role.
